name: LiquidCodec
purpose: Compact streaming audio codec that compresses speech into discrete tokens and back; the audio tokenizer behind LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B (card). Codebooks have no sequential dependencies, so speech models can predict all codebooks of a frame in parallel.

license.name: LFM Open License v1.0
license.notes: LICENSE read: Apache-2.0-style grant (copyright and patent, redistribution with license copy, change notices and attribution) but commercial use is licensed only while the user or legal entity stays below an annual revenue threshold of US$10,000,000; above it commercial use is not licensed; non-profits may use it for non-commercial or research purposes regardless of the threshold; trademarks excluded. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: symmetric, fully causal LFM3 encoder and decoder with grouped finite scalar quantization (GFSQ), 12 codebooks (FSQ levels 8,7,6,6), not an LLM
architecture.why_this_design: Card: GFSQ gives codebooks without sequential dependencies, so speech models can predict all codebooks of a frame in parallel; decoder-only quantization-aware training lets the decoder run in Q4_0.

variants.notes: 24 kHz mono speech, 12.5 Hz frames, 12 tokens per frame, about 1.65 kbps; Q4_0/Q4_K_M/Q8_0 decoders ship only inside LFM3-Audio-2B-GGUF and LFM3-Omni-2B-GGUF

pc-12gb.notes: 0.15 GB; card measured 361x real-time encode and 87x decode on one Apple M4 Max CPU thread (FP32)

mac-16-24gb.notes: speed measured by the vendor on an Apple M4 Max CPU thread

other: decoder inside LFM3-Audio-2B-GGUF and LFM3-Omni-2B-GGUF for llama.cpp
engine_support.notes: llama.cpp support only as part of the LFM3 audio GGUFs, per the card.

benchmarks.name: ViSQOL, LibriSpeech test-clean (reconstruction)
benchmarks.variant: BF16; Q4_0 decoder 4.292; X-Codec 2 4.119, NanoCodec 4.219, Mimi 12cb 4.031

benchmarks.name: Encode / decode real-time factor, FP32, one CPU thread

strengths: Very fast on CPU, 74M parameters, streaming encode and decode
weaknesses: Trained and evaluated on speech only; music, singing and environmental sound not evaluated (card)
License caps commercial use at US$10M revenue

tona_fit.reason: A component, not a user-facing model: useful only as the tokenizer if Tona ports a Liquid LFM3 speech model. Quality results are vendor-run on eight test sets; no independent check.
blockers: meaningful only together with an LFM3 audio model
